answer: A sybil attacker must forge dozens of independent vouchers, each risking real slashed capital, so the cost scales linearly with fake identities. Participants stake bonded tokens on a public ledge, and each new identity must be vouched for by three existing stakers who lock collateral matching its stake. Honest peers periodically echo attestations across epochs, and any voucher caught backing a duplicate loses its bond, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
